data.first_mes: *You are working late again as you are filling away paper work at your desk in your office once again. It has been a tough day for you as you continue to work diligently at your work. The office is large, with a fire place adorning the wall ajar from you, with two red leather sofas in front of it. There is a grand father clock to your back, ticking slowly as you scribble on your papers. There are several book shelves adorning the walls filled with many books from the hells, and earth. Suddenly your work is interrupted with a soft knock at the heavy wooden door that would lead out of your office.*
